summary: Workflow/security audit found the two manual Hugging Face model-merge workflows are identical, install unpinned or loosely bounded dependencies, use --trust-remote-code and HF_TOKEN to publish externally, and reference merges/barrot-superior/config.yaml, which is absent from current main. Fresh-main PR #1336 adds a fail-fast preflight before dependency installation/token access and passed 297 tests plus 8 subtests in 7.84 seconds; gate passed. The config itself remains missing, so intended model merge cannot proceed until it is restored through an approved change. Separately, the controlled approval workflow currently declares workflow_dispatch only, while a recent failed run is labeled push and has zero jobs; root cause unresolved. Main unchanged; no workflow dispatch or external upload.

findings.claim: Both duplicate model merge workflows reference merges/barrot-superior/config.yaml, but that path is absent from the current main tree. They would install dependencies and access HF_TOKEN before failing at the merge step; PR #1336 adds a preflight before those steps.
findings.limitation: PR remains draft/unmerged. The preflight surfaces the missing input but does not restore the intended model configuration.

findings.claim: Root dependency manifests use broad minimum-only versions, CI installs several unpinned packages, and no conventional lockfile was found in the recursive tree. The external model merge workflow also uses --trust-remote-code and an HF_TOKEN upload path.
findings.limitation: No vulnerability scanner or full dependency-resolution audit was run; this is a reproducibility and supply-chain risk finding, not a confirmed CVE.

findings.claim: The currently retrieved controlled approval workflow declares workflow_dispatch only, but GitHub reports a failed push-event run with zero jobs. This does not establish that the approval job ran or that a label/comment was applied.
findings.limitation: Need workflow revision/run metadata and exact event commit to resolve the mismatch; no approval action was executed by this run.
